collection.description: A child worries that asking why the gods are silent might be disrespectful.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) worries that asking why the gods are silent might be disrespectful.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (elder) explains that wondering is not wrongdoing.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (adult), a teacher, explains that people disagree about whether gods exist.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (child) learns that uncertainty can remain unresolved.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (adult) tells a story about divine patience as a belief.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (child) asks why another family tells a different story.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (adult), a researcher, distinguishes measurable events from spiritual claims.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (child) discovers that not every question has a testable answer.
